title: Cited story API and controlled composition

files.change: Deterministic evidence bundle; optional bounded narrative paraphrase over reviewed inputs only.
Authenticated public proxy; tenant-aware story and citation access.
New app routes; preserve existing founder-decision endpoint.

steps: Every factual sentence carries claim IDs; quote locators resolve. Reject invented names/dates/numbers and causal statements.
Story cache keyed by subject/episode/input review revision/recipe and access scope; invalidate when claims change.
Expose factual history and founder experiment separately. No guaranteed outcomes or legal advice.
Use pagination and bounded payloads; avoid adding more logic to giant ingestion/api.py.
tests: Sentence-level citation completeness and tenant-crossing denial.
Claim rejection invalidates prior story and removes it from new responses.
No-citation narrative fails closed; valid partial story retains useful reviewed facts.
completion_evidence: OpenAPI/JSON response contracts and sample payloads
API integration tests with auth and resource budgets
